_README: One of these per target: TARGETS/<n>/spec.json. This is the artifact the protocol loop turns on. 'Before' steps 3-5 produce it; 'During' works through sections[] one at a time; every claim needs an evidence string (file:line, tx hash, fork receipt, or an on-chain read). A section with an empty evidence field is OPEN, no matter how convincing it reads.

source.route: e.g. Etherscan V2 chainid=<n> + key / Sourcery / none (black-box)
source.note: if unverified, say so explicitly — it caps classic source review and the spec must say which steps are reachable

target.coverage_gap: contracts/proxies known to exist but NOT yet mapped or audited — must be non-empty or explicitly 'none'

integrations.kind: oracle / relayer / bridge / token / upgrade path / off-chain

actors.authority: EOA / EOA+7702 delegation / multisig / contract / timelock

invariants.check: how it is tested (fork call / fuzz / static)

value_movers.bounded_by: what limits the amount (cap, share math, fees, nothing)

passes.lens: e.g. flow gap / trust gap / numerical gap / fork attack

status.blocked_on: credential / unfunded env / unknown address / nothing
